position: No conversion tax. The nine IIT categories (Art. 2) do not include currency exchange; the blocker is capital-account inconvertibility (Measures Art. 3), not a tax.
Comprehensive income 3–45% progressive (Art. 3(1)); non-resident monthly deduction CNY5,000 (Art. 6(2)). Withholding + annual reconciliation (Arts. 11–13).
20% on (proceeds − basis − reasonable fees) (Arts. 3(3), 6(5)). Registration requires tax-payment proof (Art. 15).
Residents may credit foreign IIT paid, capped at the China tax on that income (Art. 7).
Cancelling hukou on emigration requires prior tax settlement (Arts. 10(5), 13).
Moving your own already-taxed principal is not automatically new U.S. income — but characterise the original income, interest, dividends and gains separately. No blanket exemption claimed.

Disposition of nonfunctional currency is a §988 transaction, ordinary by default (a)(1), (c)(1)(C). Personal-transaction exclusion fails if gain exceeds USD200 (e)(2) — not a universal USD200 deduction.
Aggregate foreign accounts >USD10,000 at any time. Separate from the tax return; automatic extension to Oct 15.
US-resident single: >USD50,000 year-end or >USD75,000 intra-year; higher tiers abroad. Filed with the return.
Report gifts/bequests from a nonresident alien/foreign estate above USD100,000 (aggregate, related parties). Foreign corp/partnership purported gifts: USD20,573 for 2026.
Credit for qualifying foreign income taxes on the same income (Form 1116); treaty-reduced-tax and excluded-income limits apply.
Applies to specified physical-instrument-funded remittances sent FROM the U.S. (from 2026-01-01), not China-to-U.S. transfers. Inherited source — see F12.
Administrative fines under the FX Administration Regulation for splitting/false documents; watchlist consequences (2020 Art. 62). Criminal referral possible — not quantified here.

FBAR civil penalties inflation-adjusted; willful up to the greater of USD100,000 or 50% of balances (pre-2016 figures on IRS table; current amounts adjusted annually). Form 8938 up to USD60,000. Criminal penalties may apply.
